[2026-09-03T00:31:53.225Z] [world] The flat silt heaves, and a hand breaks the surface, then an arm, then a face caked grey with a thousand years of it.
[2026-09-03T00:31:53.225Z] [arbiter] You've heard of these on the road: the Aetherkin, the ones the mud drowned and the Aether raised back up.
[2026-09-03T00:31:53.225Z] [world] In life it was a house-servant in the grey of some family that has no name left — they could be anyone's — a neighbour, a stranger, the person you'd have been. They surfaced out of the flat mud like a held breath finally, terribly let go.
[2026-09-03T00:31:53.225Z] [world] It looks at you the way a cornered animal looks at a door. Fight or flight, and the flight is walled off. Press it and it will strike; leave it and it will let you.
[2026-09-03T00:31:53.226Z] [world] You walk east through open silt. The compass points east into open ground.
[2026-09-03T00:31:53.226Z] [world] Whatever clock this place runs on, it has not ticked since you left.
